Title: Card Idea: Never go full retard

Messages.Author: Mephistopheles

Card Type: Unique Master
Cost: none
Card Text: Put this card into play. As long as Never go full retard is in game players are not allowed to transfer, pay for card costs or effects in a way that would reduce their pool to less than 1.

Messages.Author: Adonai
Messages.Body:
I'm on 1 pool.
My prey is the only other player in the game, with 3 pool.
I have 2 victory points, and exactly 1 minion.
My prey has 1 victory point, and two minions.
The only card left in my hand or library is Kine Resources Contested, my prey can not block, delay, or vote down the political action.

As long as your card is in play I lose and they win, because I cannot play KRC to win the game.

Neither this card proposal nor the rule change allow playing to win.
